trigger.statement: Do not treat the current V43 Prism-inspired slider/link/arm/roller chain as the required bottle-handling architecture. Solve the bottle-handling function first and compare mechanism families.

actual_path: PLAN-0009 projected an authoritative-source search for the exact seven-component V43 Prism chain. That work remains valid only if the Prism chain survives a function-first architecture comparison; continuing it as the sole path would prematurely constrain the design.

affected_step_outcomes.reason: Exact V43 kinematic source acquisition is no longer the mandatory next step; V43 becomes one candidate mechanism family.
Field-by-field binding of the exact V43 joints/actuator/limits is deferred unless V43 remains competitive after architecture screening.
No V43-specific hypothetical motion test should be prepared before mechanism-family selection.

mechanical_claim_boundary: This scope correction changes investigation priority only. It does not invalidate prior V43 observations, prove another mechanism superior, establish operating motion, or grant mechanical acceptance.
